faq.what.a: A VM is a full machine (Linux, Windows or another x86-64 system) that runs inside one of your computers. The computer gives it memory, disk and a network. You can run as many VMs as the computer has memory and disk for.
faq.bareMetal.q: Why can't my computer run VMs?
faq.bareMetal.a: VMs need a computer on a bare-metal server, with KVM turned on for that computer. Shared servers cannot run them. Turning KVM on or off needs the computer stopped: stop it, switch KVM, then start it again.
faq.screen.q: How do I see a VM's screen?
faq.screen.a: Give the VM a screen in its settings, start it, then open its Screen tab. You can also open the screen in a new tab. Copy and paste between your browser and a VM does not work; type the text, or send a line to its console from the Logs tab.
faq.windows.a: Pick a Windows preset when you make the VM and give it a screen. When the installer says "Press any key", press Enter on the Screen tab. If no disk shows in the list of drives, choose Load driver and load viostor, then NetKVM for the network, from the second disc.
faq.ports.q: How do I reach a website that runs in a VM?
faq.ports.a: Open a port on the VM's Ports tab: a port of the computer leads to a port inside the VM. A web port then has its own address, which you can copy or open. Ports can be changed while the VM is stopped.
faq.failed.q: Why did my VM stop or not start?
faq.failed.a: The VM's own screen says the last problem it had. For more, open its Logs tab: Machine shows the machine's own errors, Console what the system inside printed. A VM may not start when the computer has too little memory or disk left for it.
faq.console.q: Is the console line a terminal?
faq.console.a: No. It types one line at the VM's console, followed by Enter, and nothing else. What the VM answers shows in the Console log after a refresh. If a line's answer is lost, the page never sends it again on its own: read the console first.

settings.err.memoryFree: More than the {{free}} GiB free for VMs now: the VM will not start until memory is freed.
settings.err.vcpus: Use a whole number from 1 to 4096.
settings.err.grace: Use 5 to 900 seconds, or leave it empty.
settings.err.diskBps: Use at least 0.0625 MiB/s, or leave it empty.
settings.err.diskIops: Use at least 8, or leave it empty.
settings.err.shareQuota: Use more than 0, or leave it empty.
settings.err.audio: This VM plays sound, which needs its screen.
storage.title: Storage
storage.about: The VM's disk, its disc drives and its shared folder.
storage.grow.title: Make the disk of {{vm}} bigger
storage.grow.subtitle: A disk only grows. Afterwards, extend the partition inside the VM to use the new space.
storage.grow.err.whole: Use a whole number of GiB.
storage.grow.err.notBigger: Use more than the {{now}} it has now.
storage.grow.err.tooBig: A disk can be at most {{max}} GiB.
storage.discs.label: Disc drives of {{vm}}

storage.disc.path.help: The whole path of an .iso file on this computer, for example one you put there with Files.
storage.disc.err.missing: Enter the path of the disc image.
storage.disc.err.notAbsolute: Use a whole path that starts with /.
storage.disc.ejectTitle: Eject the disc from drive {{n}} of {{vm}}?
storage.disc.ejectBody: The VM loses the disc now. A system reading it may report an error.
storage.disc.ejectBodyStopped: The drive is empty when the VM next starts.
storage.share.over: The shared folder is over its size limit. The VM will not start until it is under the limit or the limit is raised in Settings.
settings.chg.why.notStopped: Shut the VM down to change this.
settings.chg.why.creating: The VM is still being created.
settings.chg.why.noSettings: This VM's settings could not be read.
settings.chg.why.framed: Open the Hub in its own tab to change this.
settings.chg.why.held: Another change of this VM is not confirmed yet.
settings.chg.why.sending: A change of this VM is being sent.
settings.chg.why.live.notRunning: Wait until the VM is running, or shut it down, to change the disc.
settings.chg.why.live.emptyAtStart: This drive was empty when the VM started. Shut the VM down to insert a disc.
settings.chg.why.live.stalled: This VM stopped answering. Shut it down to change discs.
settings.chg.held.settings: The new settings of {{vm}} may have gone through. It is not confirmed yet.
settings.chg.held.ports: The new ports of {{vm}} may have gone through. It is not confirmed yet.
settings.chg.held.discs: The disc change of {{vm}} may have gone through. It is not confirmed yet.
settings.chg.held.disk: Making the disk of {{vm}} bigger may have gone through. It is not confirmed yet.

settings.chg.held.eject: Ejecting the disc of {{vm}} may have gone through. It is not confirmed yet.
settings.chg.held.other: A change to {{vm}} may have gone through. It is not confirmed yet.

settings.chg.held.MemoryExceedsCgroup: The computer reported: not enough memory.
settings.chg.held.dismissBody: The page stops tracking this change. It may still have been made; look at the VM before you change it again.
settings.chg.refused.BadState: The VM is not stopped. Shut it down and try again.
settings.chg.refused.OperationInProgress: Another change of this VM is under way. Try again in a moment.
settings.chg.refused.NotFound: This VM is no longer there.
settings.chg.refused.SpecInvalid: The computer did not accept these values.
settings.chg.refused.PortForwardConflict: A port on the computer is already used by another VM.
settings.chg.refused.DisplayRangeExhaust: No free screen number on this computer. Turn off the screen of a VM you do not use.
settings.chg.refused.DisplayInUse: The screen number is used by something else.
settings.chg.refused.other: The computer did not make this change.
